· 현재가(30,040원) vs SMA5(30,847원)/SMA20(31,298원)/SMA50(34,445원): 단기·중기 하회, 중장기 추세 약화

[모멘텀 지표]

· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-179.3047→161.0457): 개선세 보이나 약세 수렴 지속, 추세 전환 신호 미약

[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 (29,960원): 피벗 S1(24,595원) 대비 상단, 5일 저가(28,455원) 대비 상단

· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴: 횡보 구간, Higher Low 또는 Lower High 미확인
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (1.42배): 5일 평균 대비 급증, 움직임에 힘 실림
· 현 구간 진단: 축적 구간, 추세 전환 신호 확인 필요
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (30,040 KRW) vs SMA5 (30,847 KRW)/SMA20 (31,298 KRW)/SMA50 (34,445 KRW): below short/mid-term, weakening long-term trend
· Significantly lower relative to SMA100 (37,595 KRW)/SMA200 (36,379 KRW): indicating weakened long-term trend
· 52-week position (33.3%) + current price range near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (49.0→43.1): entering oversold territory, downward momentum persists
· MACD histogram trajectory (-179.3047→161.0457): showing improvement but weak convergence continues, weak trend reversal signal
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band 31,298 KRW): trading around the mid-band, lacking directionality
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (29,960 KRW): above Pivot S1 (24,595 KRW), above 5-day low (28,455 KRW)
· Swing resistance (30,570 KRW): short-term resistance zone, break above targets 5-day high (33,675 KRW)
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: sideways range, neither Higher Low nor Lower High confirmed
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.42x): surge compared to 5-day average, adding conviction to price movement
· Current phase diagnosis: Accumulation phase, trend reversal signal confirmation needed
